title: agathis macrophylla subsp. obtusa
intro: Agathis macrophylla subsp. obtusa, commonly known as the Daintree Rosewood, is a species of coniferous tree native to the tropical rainforests of Far North Queensland, Australia. This tree is valued for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Agathis macrophylla subsp. obtusa include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, triterpenes, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
